post_model_calibration.description: Guardrailed IPL post-model calibration router. Inn1 corrects p<0.50 downward; Inn2 sharpens easy-chase 50-85 and par 50-80 only where OOS supports it: PP full par bucket, MID negative-par bucket. Fit on 2025 OOS, validated on 2026 holdout against raw v14.

pp_low_fallback_rule: phase == pp and target_above_par < -20 uses models/ipl_v12 champion_model_pp raw probability
